preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 70 and 1 <= M <= 70 and 1 <= K <= 70 for N, M, K in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N, M, and K are between 1 and 70 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of output values matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(S, int) and S >= 0 for S in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value S is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(S == min_stones(N, M, K) for (N, M, K), S in zip(test_cases, output))
postconditions.description: Each output value S is the smallest possible value for the maximum number of stones in any cell after K journeys.
